```{r}
# 1. Define the vector with ALL model variables (the row headers)
all_vars <- c(
  "age", "race1", "race2", "race3", "race4", "race5", "race9", 
  "household_size", "family_structureunipessoal", "household_income", 
  "household_income_pcapita", "education_years", "wealth_index", 
  "head_dependency", "worker_statusinformal", "worker_statusnao_informado", 
  "worker_statusservidor_publico", "worker_statustrabalhador_formal", 
  "single_momnao_mae_solteira", "metropolitan_areanao_area_metropolitana", 
  "macroregionnordeste", "macroregionnorte", "macroregionsudeste", "macroregionsul"
)

# 2. Group your results into a named list.
# Replace the placeholder variables below with your actual LASSO-generated vectors.
results_list <- list(
  "Norte"        = select_vars_norte,       
  "Nordeste"     = select_vars_nordeste,
  "Sudeste"      = select_vars_sudeste,
  "Sul"          = select_vars_sul,
  "Centro-Oeste" = select_vars_centroeste,
  "Nacional"     = select_vars_national
)

# 3. Run the function
final_table <- create_selection_table(all_vars, results_list)

# View the result
View(final_table)
```

## Post-LASSO

```{r}
saveRDS(post_lasso_national, "post_lasso_national.rds")
```

```{r}
# Extract the raw summary object
mod_sum <- summary(post_lasso_national)

# Search for the matrix
if ("coeftable" %in% names(mod_sum)) {
  raw_matrix <- mod_sum$coeftable
} else if ("coefficients" %in% names(mod_sum)) {
  raw_matrix <- mod_sum$coefficients
} else if ("coef3" %in% names(mod_sum)) {
  raw_matrix <- mod_sum$coef3
} else {
  raw_matrix <- as.matrix(mod_sum)
}

# Get categories
all_levels <- pnadc$variables$tenure_condition
estimated_levels <- all_levels[-1]

clean_df <- data.frame(
  Term = rownames(raw_matrix),
  Estimate_B = as.numeric(raw_matrix[, 1]),
  Std_Error = as.numeric(raw_matrix[, 2]),
  Wald_z = as.numeric(raw_matrix[, 3]),
  Sig = as.numeric(raw_matrix[, 4]),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Clean the text, Map Categories, and calculate Odds Ratio
clean_df$Variable <- sub(":.*", "", clean_df$Term)
clean_df$Eq_Index <- as.numeric(sub(".*:", "", clean_df$Term))
clean_df$Equation <- estimated_levels[clean_df$Eq_Index]
clean_df$Exp_B <- exp(clean_df$Estimate_B)

# Order the columns exactly as needed
final_data <- clean_df[, c("Equation", "Variable", "Estimate_B", "Std_Error", "Wald_z", "Sig", "Exp_B")]

# Render table
final_table <- final_data %>%
  group_by(Equation) %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    Estimate_B = "Estimate B",
    Std_Error = "Std. error",
    Wald_z = "Wald",
    Sig = "Sig.",
    Exp_B = "Exp(B)"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(Estimate_B, Std_Error, Wald_z, Sig, Exp_B),
    decimals = 3
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = Sig, rows = Sig < 0.05)
  ) %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**TABLE 4**"),
    subtitle = "Multinomial logit model tenure choice"
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    row_group.font.weight = "bold",
    row_group.background.color = "#f0f0f0",
    table.border.top.color = "black",
    table.border.bottom.color = "black",
    table_body.hlines.color = "lightgray"
  )

final_table
```

```{r}
predicted_probs <- predict(post_lasso_national, type = "response")
predicted_class <- colnames(predicted_probs)[max.col(predicted_probs, ties.method = "first")]

observed_class <- pnadc$variables$tenure_condition
observation_weight <- pnadc$variables$V1032

df_matriz <- data.frame(
  Predicted = predicted_class,
  Observed = observed_class,
  Weight = observation_weight
)

weighted_confusion_matrix <- xtabs(Weight ~ Predicted + Observed, data = df_matriz)
rounding <- round(weighted_confusion_matrix, 0)
formatted_matrix <- format(rounding, 
                           scientific = FALSE, 
                           big.mark = ".",
                           decimal.mark = ",")

print("Matriz de Confusão Ponderada (Número Real de Domicílios):")
print(formatted_matrix)
```

```{r}
weighted_accuracy <- sum(diag(weighted_confusion_matrix)) / sum(weighted_confusion_matrix)
weighted_accuracy
```

```{r}
# 1. Calculate precision: diagonal (correct predictions) divided by row sums (total predictions per category)
precision_values <- diag(weighted_confusion_matrix) / rowSums(weighted_confusion_matrix)

# Handle potential NaN values if a category was never predicted (row sum = 0)
precision_values[is.na(precision_values)] <- 0

# 2. Convert to percentage and round to 1 decimal place
precision_percent <- round(precision_values * 100, 1)

# 3. Create a clean summary data frame
precision_table <- data.frame(
  Categoria = names(precision_percent),
  Precisao_Pct = paste0(precision_percent, "%"),
  Valores_Exatos = precision_percent
)

print("Precisão (% de acertos das previsões) por Categoria:")
print(precision_table)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

cm_df <- as.data.frame(weighted_confusion_matrix)

ggplot(cm_df, aes(x = Predicted, y = Observed, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = format(round(Freq, 0), big.mark = "."),
      color = Freq > (max(Freq) / 2)
    ), 
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "white", "FALSE" = "black"), guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette = "Blues", 
    direction = 1,
    labels = label_number(scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Categoria prevista",
    y = "Categoria observada",
    fill = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "plain"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```
